name: repr-bioclim
cmd: set -e; for c in gp_species_base desk_tempho_1995; do {python} research/exp/bioclim.py --cache {cache}/$c --out {out}/$c/bioclim; {python} research/exp/repr_regime.py --cache {cache}/$c --out {out}/$c --bioclim-dir {out}/$c/bioclim; done
summarize: for c in gp_species_base desk_tempho_1995; do {python} research/exp/repr_regime.py --summarize {out}/$c; done
note: E039c: desk vs 19 BIOCLIM (+12 LUH classes), matched N=19, BLR readout, thinned data, by prevalence tier
